test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Prakash starts from Point A and drives 30 km towards East. He then takes a right turn, drives 18 km, turns right and drives 17 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 9 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 13 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?

(All turns are 90 degree turns only unless otherwise specified.)
solution:
Given:

Prakash starts from Point A and drives 30 km towards East.

He then takes a right turn, drives 18 km, turns right and drives 17 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 9 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 13 km and stops at Point P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a071fbcd87214615b111cb37b652c4905b95f1b6a306a5af802d58bfb21aa967.png] 

Thus, Prakash should drive (18 km - 9 km) 9 km in the north direction in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
